question: Should Discord subagent progress ship with this seven-setting public configuration and separate channel lifecycle callback, or should reactions be integrated into the existing source-message reaction owner or narrowed to typing-only liveness?
rationale: The remaining collision is mechanically repairable, but automation cannot choose the permanent Discord UX, configuration footprint, or plugin/channel lifecycle contract.

options.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
options.body: Keep count, failure, and typing progress while resolving acknowledgements, status, and progress through one effective source-message reaction ownership contract.

options.title: Narrow To Typing
options.body: Ship typing liveness first and defer progress reactions, their configuration, and the lifecycle API expansion.

options.title: Approve Separate Tracker
options.body: Retain the parallel tracker only after every effective emoji precedence and cleanup rule is documented, tested, and explicitly accepted.

recommendation.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
recommendation.body: Keep count, failure, and typing progress while resolving acknowledgements, status, and progress through one effective source-message reaction ownership contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history spans the shared reaction controller, Discord reaction targeting, channel lifecycle SDK, agent identity resolution, and subagent lifecycle boundary needed for this decision.
